what_this_is: How the dossier beside it was shaped, so the reader knows what it is looking at and what it is not. It describes the SHAPING, never the file: every sentence here is the same on every file in every corpus, and nothing in it is evidence.
closed_world: The dossier is the whole of what was sent. There is no document behind it, no page, no filename, no path, no surrounding sentence, and no part of the tree beyond the candidates listed. A destination can only be an identifier present in allowed_vocabulary, and a citation can only be anchored in a value present in released_evidence.

selection.unit: one file version and the shortlist of situations the recognisers raised for it
selection.what_is_offered: observations the local extractors already produced for that version, each addressed by an observation_key and bounded by a span; the shortlisted situations, each described by what kind of material it is and whether it is one of the four protected kinds; and the recogniser's own report of why it stopped
selection.what_is_never_offered: the whole tree, complete extracted text, whole documents, paths, filenames, OCR output of protected material, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, the person's own typed words, and raw sensitive values
selection.ordering: situations in the recognisers' order, which carries no meaning for the answer; evidence in the document's own order, bounded
selection.bounded: the count and the length are both capped before the request is built; what did not fit was not sent and is not described

reduction_ladder: none: the dossier fits and is sent unreduced
summarized_facts: facts stand in for their evidence
preserved_anchors: only the anchoring evidence is kept
split: the subject is sent as several dossiers, each judged on its own
reduction_rung_in_force: the dossier's own reduction_rung key says which rung this one was built at
redaction: identifiers the local policy recognises are transformed before the value is written into the dossier. A redacted value is the value that was sent, and it is the only text a citation can quote.
what_is_done_with_the_answer: the situation is checked against allowed_vocabulary; every citation is checked against the released value it names, and a situation named with no citation is an unknown and writes no record; restricted_kind, when present, is checked against the ten restricted kinds and written as the file's privacy class; nothing is filed by this answer -- it decides which questions the file is asked and whether it may reach a cloud model
declining: a destination of none is recorded as a correct abstention and the file goes to a person. It is not a failure and it is not counted as one.
